notesI18n.zh: 第三方/DeepSeek 服务商默认使用 1M 上下文窗口，大幅减少频繁自动压缩；新增 128K/256K/512K/1M 快捷预设。修复新建会话后首条消息需要按两次回车的问题，选中目录下发送与上传会自动创建正式会话。
notesI18n.en: Third-party and DeepSeek providers now default to a 1M context window, greatly reducing frequent auto-compaction, with 128K/256K/512K/1M quick presets. Fixed the first message after creating a session requiring a second Enter; sending or uploading with a selected directory now creates the real session automatically.
